name: Crosswind

profile.Signature Ability: Intersecting Currents — Creates multiple air currents moving in different directions to disrupt enemy movement and balance.
profile.Weapon/Medium: Dual short blades formed from condensed Air magic
profile.Strengths: Exceptional aerial mobility, disciplined combat techniques, strategic preparation, precision, strong determination and outstanding control over intersecting air currents.
profile.Weaknesses: Perfectionism, difficulty accepting defeat, tendency to overtrain, frustration when facing unpredictable opponents, and occasional difficulty recognising her own progress.
profile.Fear: Becoming helpless when someone needs her protection
profile.Rivals: Luma Blossom — Her greatest rival and the Guardian she is determined to surpass.
profile.Loves: Friendly competitions, flying, winning a difficult match
profile.Likes: Training, teasing friends, exploring new places, trying new food
profile.Dislikes: Being underestimated, opponents holding back, unnecessary restrictions
profile.Hates: People who abuse their strength to intimidate others
profile.Personality: Crosswind is serious, disciplined, ambitious, and fiercely competitive. She takes great pride in her abilities and constantly pushes herself to improve, believing that hard work and determination are the keys to becoming stronger. She is particularly determined to surpass Luma Blossom, whom she considers her greatest rival. Crosswind dislikes losing and can become frustrated when her carefully prepared strategies fail against Blossom's unpredictable fighting style. However, she never makes excuses or resorts to unfair methods, preferring to analyse her mistakes and train harder. Despite her intense competitiveness, she respects Blossom's abilities and remains a reliable Guardian who prioritises civilian safety over personal victories. Beneath her stern exterior, Crosswind genuinely values those who challenge her to become better.
Personality Example: After losing a match: Crosswind remains silent while reviewing the battle recording. When Blossom approaches to compliment her performance, Crosswind replies, "I lost. That's all that matters right now." Later, after calming down, she acknowledges Blossom's compliment and returns to training.

During a rematch: Crosswind notices Blossom attempting a new manoeuvre. Rather than reacting impulsively, she adjusts her wind currents and forces Blossom into a difficult position. "I've studied that movement. It won't work twice."

After Blossom wins again: Crosswind approaches her, still catching her breath. "I'm going to beat you someday." Blossom nods. "I know." Crosswind pauses, briefly caught off guard by the genuine confidence in her response.
profile.Core Idea of character: A highly disciplined Air Guardian who dedicates herself to surpassing Blossom, believing that relentless effort and preparation can overcome even extraordinary natural talent.
Quotes: "I don't want you to go easy on me. I want to defeat you at your best."
"You can adapt to anything? Then I'll become someone you can't keep up with."
"I lost today. That doesn't mean I'll lose tomorrow."
Background
Luma Crosswind was awakened by Luma Gale in 2016 after demonstrating an unusually strong affinity for Air magic.
Under Gale's mentorship, she developed exceptional speed, aerial mobility and control over moving air currents.
Her powers eventually evolved into the Crosswind branch, allowing her to generate intersecting wind currents that move in different directions simultaneously.
Crosswind became a Full-Fledged Guardian in 2020, placing her in the same generation as Luma Blossom.
Rivalry with Luma Blossom
Crosswind first encountered Blossom during a joint Guardian training exercise shortly after they became Full-Fledged.
Crosswind was confident in her speed and aerial abilities, having frequently outperformed other disciples in mobility-based exercises.
However, Blossom's extraordinary flexibility and adaptability allowed her to evade Crosswind's attacks despite lacking Air magic.
Their first sparring match ended in a draw.
Impressed and somewhat frustrated, Crosswind immediately requested a rematch.
Their rivalry developed naturally through repeated training sessions and occasional joint missions.
Crosswind specialises in disrupting Blossom's movement using unpredictable air currents, while Blossom continuously adapts her fighting techniques to counter them.
Although Crosswind takes their competitions more seriously, Blossom genuinely enjoys the challenge and respects her abilities.
The two eventually develop a friendly rivalry built on mutual trust, competition and admiration.
During real missions, they cooperate effectively, combining Crosswind's aerial control with Blossom's acrobatics and precise Fire attacks.
Crosswind is one of the few Guardians who can consistently challenge Blossom's mobility, while Blossom remains one of the few opponents capable of keeping up with Crosswind without controlling Air.
Their rivalry continues even as both gain more experience, with neither willing to admit that training together has made them stronger.

other.Appearance: Shoulder-length dark brown hair, teal eyes in Guardian form, athletic build.
